sloka: तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा बलाध्यक्षो निशाचरः।स्यन्दनं च बलं चैव समीपं प्रत्यपादयत् ।। ६.७८.७ ।।
transliteration: tasya tadvacanaṁ śrutvā balādhyakṣo niśācaraḥ।syandanaṁ ca balaṁ caiva samīpaṁ pratyapādayat ।। 6.78.7 ।।

translations.english: Upon hearing those words, the commanderinchief of the Rakshasas responded and placed the army near him.
